buildSettings.description: These are the default configurations for a {framework} project. If your project requires different settings, you can modify them as needed.
buildSettings.outputFileDescription: The path to the app’s starting file. For built projects, it’s the file created after building (e.g., 'dist/main.js'). For non-built projects, it’s the file used to run the app.

usefulLinks.dialogDescription: Here are some resources to assist you during deployment:

welcome.title: Welcome to Auto-CICD
welcome.description: This quick tour will show you how to find your projects and deploy them. Let's get started!

subgroup.title: Filter by Subgroup
subgroup.description: Use this dropdown to filter projects by your team's subgroup. Your personal subgroup is selected automatically if found.

search.title: Search Projects
search.description: Type a project name here to quickly find it. Results are sorted by relevance when you search.

sort.title: Sort Projects
sort.description: Change the order in which projects are listed — by name or by last activity.

projectCard.title: Your Projects
projectCard.description: Each card represents a GitLab project. Click the project name to open it in GitLab, or use the Deploy button below to start the deployment setup.

deployBtn.title: Deploy Button
deployBtn.description: Click Deploy to open the deployment configuration for this project. Auto-CICD will detect your framework and generate the necessary files automatically.

moreInfo.title: More Information
moreInfo.description: Need help or have questions? Click this button to access the support portal with guides and documentation for Auto-CICD.

framework.title: Framework Detection
framework.description: Auto-CICD automatically detects your project's framework. If the detection is wrong, you can select the correct one from this dropdown. The package manager is also detected and can be changed here.

buildSettings.title: Build & Output Settings
buildSettings.description: Expand this section to customize build commands, the output file path, and the port. For most common frameworks the defaults work out of the box — only change these if your project has special needs.

envSettings.title: Environment Variables
envSettings.description: Expand this section to add or update your project's environment variables. You can paste your entire .env file here. Variables are stored securely in GitLab CI/CD settings.

deployAction.title: Deploy
deployAction.description: When you're ready, click Deploy. You'll be shown a preview of all files that will be committed to your repository — you can uncheck any file you don't want to include.

fileList.title: Review Files to Commit
fileList.description: These are the deployment configuration files that will be committed to your repository. Expand any file to preview its contents. Uncheck a file to exclude it from this commit.

dockerfile.title: Customize After Deploy
dockerfile.description: After deployment you can always edit the Dockerfile directly in GitLab if your project needs a custom base image, extra dependencies, or multi-stage build steps. Any change pushed to the main branch re-triggers the pipeline automatically.

continueBtn.title: Confirm & Deploy
continueBtn.description: Click Continue to commit the selected files and trigger your CI/CD pipeline. The deployment usually completes within a few minutes.

auth.signInMessage: Sign in to your account to access your projects and deploy them.

errors.profile: Error retrieving user profile from GitLab.

errors.fetchProjects: Failed to fetch projects. Please try again.
